test_objective: If the count parameter is set to true the special HTTP header NGSILD-Results-Count is set in the response and it must contain the total number of matching results.

test_cases.name: 019_07_01 Check that the total number of matching results is returned if the count parameter is set to true and only the entity type is provided
test_cases.doc: If the count parameter is set to true the special HTTP header NGSILD-Results-Count is set in the response and it must contain the total number of matching results.
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entities Request: and
    Query Parameter: entity_types set to 'Building' and
    Query Parameter: q set to '${q}' and
    Query Parameter: count set to '${True}' and
    Query Parameter: Link set to '<$https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld>; rel="http://www.w3.org/ns/json-ld#context";type="application/ld+json"'
}
